Pests We Eliminate

Every Common Alabama Pest, Handled.

From the small stuff to the big nuisances. If it's an Alabama pest, we've treated for it.

🐜
Ants
Argentine, sugar, carpenter, fire ants — every Alabama species, treated at the colony level.
🪳
Roaches
American, German, smoky brown — interior baiting and exterior perimeter prevention.
🕷️
Spiders
Brown recluse, black widow, common house spiders — eliminated and prevented from returning.
🐭
Rodents
Mice and rats inside homes, attics, and crawlspaces. We eliminate, then seal entry points.
🦗
Crickets
Field and camel crickets — common in Alabama basements and garages, especially in fall.
🐞
Beetles
Carpet beetles, ladybugs, weevils, kudzu beetles — interior and exterior treatment.
🦂
Earwigs & Centipedes
Moisture pests common around foundations, decks, and damp basement areas.
🐝
Bees & Wasps
Carpenter bees in wood. Wasps and hornets in eaves. Safe, professional removal.
How Our Quarterly Plan Works

Four Visits a Year. Pests Gone, And Stay Gone.

01
Free Inspection
Licensed tech walks your property and identifies activity, entry points, and risk areas. You get a written quote — no obligation.
02
Initial Treatment
Thorough exterior perimeter + interior knockdown if needed. Long-lasting barrier products applied where pests travel.
03
Quarterly Visits
Every 90 days we re-treat the perimeter, refresh the barrier, and check for new activity.
04
Free Re-Visits
See a pest between treatments? Call us. We come back free until the problem is solved. That's the EnviroCare guarantee.
